body: {"format_version": "behavior-test-case-v1", "case_id": "TC-007", "title": "Authentication failure when controller's challenge has invalid DH value length", "purpose": "branch", "test_level": "business_blackbox", "entry": "spdk_nvme_qpair_authenticate(qpair, cb_fn, cb_ctx)", "preconditions": ["Host has dhchap_key set", "Host configures a non-NULL dhgroup (e.g., ffdhe2048)", "No authentication currently in progress", "Controller sends a challenge with dhvlen=0 or dhvlen too large for NVME_AUTH_DATA_SIZE for the given dhgroup"], "steps": [{"action": "Call spdk_nvme_qpair_authenticate and poll until challenge is received", "expected": "State progresses to AWAIT_CHALLENGE; nvme_auth_check_challenge validates dhvlen per dhgroup and fails for dhvlen=0 or overflow"], {"action": "Continue polling until poll returns -EACCES", "expected": "nvme_auth_set_failure called; FAILURE2 sent; state becomes AWAIT_FAILURE2; poll returns -EACCES"}], "external_observations": ["nvme_fabric_qpair_authenticate_poll returns -EACCES", "auth->status == -EACCES", "FAILURE2 sent with reason=SPDK_NVMF_AUTH_INCORRECT_PAYLOAD"], "cleanup": ["Retry with a properly configured controller"], "flow_refs": [{"flow_id": "F-002", "path_id": "P-07"}], "coverage_refs": [], "risk_refs": [], "variants": [], "execution_status": "not_run", "source_evidence": ["spdk-full:lib/nvme/nvme_auth.c:856-879 (dhvlen validation per dhgroup)", "spdk-full:lib/nvme/nvme_auth.c:869-874 (overflow check: sizeof(*challenge) + hl + challenge->dhvlen > NVME_AUTH_DATA_SIZE)"]}
